title: De la Flora
html_source: Of course, Molly does marry a man named Bloom.

anchor.prefix: outh his mouth was sweetlike young I put my knee up to him a few times to learn the way what did I tell him I was engaged for fun to the son of a Spanish nobleman named Don Miguel
anchor.suffix: and he believed me that I was to be married to him in 3 years time theres many a true word spoken in jest there is a flower that bloometh a few things I told him true about 1932#6
